registered_before: capped diagnostic collection, no final held-out outcomes used
calibration: existing training expert IK per-step joint bound; motivated by development GRU p99 jumps .349-.374rad versus teacher .018rad
applies_to: all seven right-arm target joints after each controller call, every policy and every phase including locomotion; other joints and gripper unchanged
initialization: own encoder arm positions on first step, previous actually executed target thereafter
information: requested command and own encoders only; no evaluator truth, teacher phase, teacher action or task-specific fallback
report: strict physical success, complete failures, requested/executed target differences and clipped fractions, unchanged frozen checkpoints
originals: uncapped development and frozen original comparison retained separately
final: only after development audit, any evaluation uses common limiter for all compared policies; retain original comparator
limitation: command-rate bound is not measured joint-velocity/force limit or collision guarantee; not proof of general neural-policy robustness
